SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, min(calendar_date) AS d0, max(calendar_date) AS d1, count(*) AS days, sum(CASE WHEN is_trading_day THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS closed_days, max(weeks_in_fiscal_year) AS wk_in_year
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period = 2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(c.net_sales) AS ctl_net
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = c.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26') AND c.store_id <> 999
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, w.net_sales, c.ctl_net, w.net_sales - c.ctl_net AS gap
FROM weekly w JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week) ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT d.fiscal_year,
       count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_line_ids,
       count(*) - count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dup_receipt_lines,
       sum(CASE WHEN f.store_key IS NULL OR f.product_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_keys,
       count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(f.sale_date) AS mn, max(f.sale_date) AS mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1

SELECT o.status, count(*) AS lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, min(f.sale_date) AS mn, max(f.sale_date) AS mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-05-20' AND '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key

)
SELECT ty.fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week,
       ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
